title: Same-Day AI Proofs of Valiant's Conjecture (VP ≠ VNP)
aiSystem: Internal Claude + Lean 4 (Anthropic) & OpenAI Frontier Model + Lean 4
whyItMatters: Anthropic and OpenAI posted independent Lean-formalized AI proofs of the 47-year-old algebraic analogue of P ≠ NP within five hours of each other.
summary: On November 23, 2026, Anthropic published a 70-page Claude-authored paper and Lean 4 formalization claiming to prove Leslie Valiant's 1979 conjecture VP ≠ VNP—the algebraic analogue of P vs. NP separating the determinant from the permanent. Hours later, OpenAI added its own independent Lean-backed proof ('VP and VNP are different') to openai/math, noting its internal model had obtained the result on November 6. Complexity theorists hailed the simultaneous dual-lab Lean releases as unprecedented while emphasizing that independent specification audits and human mathematical digestion are still underway.
technicalHighlights: Targets Valiant's 1979 conjecture separating polynomial-sized algebraic circuits (VP) from algebraic NP (VNP).
Two rival labs released independent Lean 4 proofs hours apart on November 23, 2026 (with OpenAI's internal proof dated November 6).
Backed by public Lean 4 formalizations currently undergoing independent community axiom, definition, and exposition audits.
caveats: Neither proof has yet completed full independent human refereeing or Mathlib/Lean-community sign-off; even if confirmed, VP ≠ VNP does not immediately imply Boolean P ≠ NP.

scoreRationale.foundational: If verified, resolves the central open conjecture of algebraic complexity theory and the closest major stepping stone toward P vs. NP.
scoreRationale.ripple: Would reshape geometric complexity theory (GCT), lower-bound techniques, and permanent/determinant theory.
scoreRationale.verification: Lean formalizations are public, but independent verification of definitions and proof validity is still pending.
scoreRationale.velocity: Two independent AI solutions to a 47-year-old landmark conjecture posted within five hours of each other.
